notes.title: Meet us at Gamescom 2025
notes.content:
🎉 Medieval Frontiers is Heading to Gamescom!
We’re thrilled to announce that Medieval Frontiers will be making its public debut at Gamescom this year! 🏰✨

If you’re attending, you’ll have the chance to play an exclusive build of the game, meet members of the dev team, and get a closer look at life on the frontier before our next big public playtest.
📍 Where to Find Us
Gamescom 2025 – Home of Indies - Halle 10.2
From 20. - 24. August 
🛠️ What You’ll See at Gamescom
Hands-on gameplay demo

Sneak peek at new features since the last playtest

Updated visuals, systems, and AI behavior

A few surprises we can’t reveal just yet 😉

We’ll also be sharing photos, updates, and behind-the-scenes moments from the show floor, so even if you can’t make it to Gamescom, you can still follow along right here on Steam and on our socials.
[hr][/hr]
If you’re at the event, drop by and say hello — we’d love to meet you in person!

– Active Fungus Studios

notes.title: 🏁 Medieval Frontiers Playtest Has Ended – Thank You, Pioneers!
notes.content:
Well met, settlers of the frontier!

The Medieval Frontiers playtest has officially come to a close, and we want to give a huge thank you to everyone who joined us on the frontier. 🏰✨

Your time, feedback, and support have been invaluable in helping us shape the early foundations of the game. Every bug you reported, every suggestion you made, and every story you shared will help us improve Medieval Frontiers for the road ahead.

💬 What’s Next?

We’ll now be reviewing all the feedback, fixing issues, and working on new features for the next phase of development. Keep an eye on this page for future updates, dev blogs, and announcements about the next time you can jump back into the world.

If you want to join our betatesting team you can do so on our discord:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36329779/58394087fa50a45a4fa5fc99b14b4ac5191b7a8b.png
❤️ Thank You!

This was just the beginning, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Your enthusiasm has been a huge boost to the team, and we’re excited to bring you an even better frontier experience next time.

Until then — sharpen your tools, gather your provisions, and be ready for the call to return.

– Active Fungus Studios

notes.title: The wait is over — the Medieval Frontiers playtest is officially live! 🏰✨
notes.content:
You can now dive into the early frontier experience, build your homestead, manage your settlers, and face the wild unknown. Your feedback during this phase will be incredibly important in helping us refine the core gameplay systems and prioritize what comes next.

[previewyoutube=MvPVTvSFX3A;full][/previewyoutube]

This is an early look at the foundation of the game — expect bugs, unbalanced systems, and plenty of things to polish. But that’s where you come in!

🔹 How to Join:

 Visit the Medieval Frontiers Steam page
 Click "Request Access" (if you haven’t already)
 Download the playtest build and start playing!

🔍 What’s in the Playtest:

 Explore the early mechanics of settlement building
 Harvest resources, craft materials and build a small settlement
 Encounter the challenges and hardships of life on the frontier
 Find other survivors out in the wilderness

📣 We Want Your Feedback!
Join the discussion on our [Steam forums / Discord / community page — [https://steamcommunity.com/app/1207360/discussions/], report bugs, share your thoughts, or just tell us what worked (and what didn’t).

Thank you for being part of this journey from the very beginning. Now grab your tools, rally your settlers, and carve your legacy on the frontier.
– The Medieval Frontiers Dev Team

notes.title: ⚒ Devlog #3: Raising Walls in Medieval Frontiers – Crafting, Timber by Timber
notes.content:
⚒ Devlog: Raising Walls in Medieval Frontiers – Crafting, Timber by Timber
Well met, settlers of the frontier!

Today we bring tidings from the construction yard — a closer look at the heart of craftsmanship in Medieval Frontiers. When you raise a hall, a homestead, or a complete settlement in these wild lands, know this: it is your own hand that builds it, beam by beam, stone by stone.
A Builder’s Journey – No Clicks, Only Craft
In Medieval Frontiers, we do not conjure houses with a single command. Nay — we build them as our forebears did: piece by piece. Each structure is born of your labor and your tools. When you place a wall, what you see is not a finished shape, but the beginning of a process:
[olist]
The great wooden beams are first laid, forming the bones of your structure.

Next, connecting timbers are hammered into place, locking the frame together.

Wattle and boards fill the gaps, shaping walls and doorways.

At last, stones are set, sealing the frame into a strong, lasting wall.
[/olist]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfkFmVfqJ8s5l_4BTW6cdStSAnfyQzyq5SVQHpFbH-myJJqVDPY93wMHckxiPpN0mFUX94Kur8zaOqog-Vu4cqspTVTndftuUuJGOjlFguHYAe2cFsJvoRlTP1UReim8cMZgXvmBg?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"]

All this unfolds before your eyes, from your own hands, with hammer in hand and sweat on brow. As you build, the structure takes shape before you — real, rough, and rising with each blow of your mallet.
Gather with Purpose
In many lands beyond the frontier, builders are left to stumble — gathering too much, or too little, unsure what their next wall or roof might demand. But in Medieval Frontiers, such waste is banished.

When you mark a construction site, it shall be etched into your memory — and displayed upon thy HUD. From that moment on, the needs of the structure are made plain: how many logs, how many stones, how much iron. No more guesswork, no more burdening thy back with unneeded weight.

Every journey to the forest, every haul from the hills is guided with intent. The builder knows what he seeks, and returns with purpose — not in folly. 'Tis a simple thing, yet it brings order to the chaos of construction.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfLq4iZQ3TDWQDsGrwVrezT6h9kp91OLRkuRAxntlOGXI-FpqeSwIPwBycbUaTaZYNlVFJbWQ2KCOLzzIB2q1TxywISQsVbeYEUkJ1T1JPBwJDTJiXmf4vpAnmgX1r1ImjA0z-oug?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"]
A Home Is More Than Walls
Once your walls rise and your roof stands strong, you may furnish your dwelling as you see fit. Tables, chests, workbenches, and hearths — all may be placed freely within your home. Should you move a piece close to a wall, it shall snap into place with purpose, adopting a form that suits its surroundings. For each furnishing bears two faces — one for open space, and one for the wall — so that your homestead remains not only practical, but pleasing to the eye.

Whether you're placing a rugged workbench against a timber beam or setting a freestanding table by the hearth, your home shall reflect your own vision and taste.
Of Great Halls and Humble Huts Alike
Whether you build a humble woodshed or a towering longhall, the craft remains ever the same. No incantation will raise your roof, no spell will lay your stone. Each beam is set by your own hand, each wall forged through honest toil.

But even the strongest arms may falter beneath the weight of greater works. And so, should your ambition stretch beyond your strength, you must brave the wilds — for there, amid ruin and wilderness, you may find others in need.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeuy0qg0EJIV6Ws80HQL4yvSRvcWYTb6-YgiiBIhsBvgFiTxSp0Zy1U8XYMscd5PZ-rciuxUh5Tafyso7L-Zb-XTtraYw3zsvuwaxbbBLOPwesFqT6Pv3uYV_0b8eMqaQMQ34cyTg?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"]

They are survivors, their villages burned, their homes lost to war or worse. Scattered across the frontier, they cling to life in hidden glades, frozen passes, or the shadow of crumbling towers. Wolves stalk the woods, swamps swallow the careless, and the mountains bite with frost and wind — yet if you endure these trials, you may earn their trust.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfA1YlgwXyc1f3jFM8W9Wi1w7QOe18OuBEEvNySRIXBGIwXG2YiJwVMSaYbkardoYnmZvvJZ9DaHlGoNNnsX0hksL5z3p-ZNkk3uA6Jpn6eJONl8fj1jv2q3DZyAR97sj6GaJhHWw?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"]

Shelter them. Feed them. And in return, they may take up hammer and hatchet by your side, helping to raise walls not just for survival, but for a new beginning.

In Medieval Frontiers, every great hall begins as a dream — but with hands, hearts, and hardship shared, it may yet rise from the ashes.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfRH_Clbkofz8PqDWhBFAqIvIAySai_eN6RKW1IFzUh6khXb6TGotjAPaxhNvoHbeizThtKWyXHPZs_7afMGF1P7se8-gIb6A8HVUW-UoX6xzSgYVfyk_fZlbjA25UmTZqjlEE9xQ?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"]


[hr][/hr]

Join Us in Building the Frontier
The land is wild and the work is hard, but with courage and craft, your legacy will endure. We invite you, brave builder, to take up hammer and saw, to gather your kin and forge a home in the untamed wilds.

May your walls stand strong and your fires burn bright.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXft79jBZm2QM8qiAal4_Id1IIWDf5q45XzhJ9aFDvDirnGMukSTSLHwV_lXi_gC9L0JN5G8ewmf3QrrhANufVmEBRRuhe_9axMEmRPDHA_Ob8NOTDvUxHmqCAmwOAGrAC2gnawl?key=jDw1br9u-PoVbOFqdTVEqg"]

If the spirit of the frontier calls to you, mark your place now! Add Medieval Frontiers to your wishlist, that you may be the first to answer when the call to build and conquer is sounded. Let not this chance slip like mist at dawn—prepare your hammer and ready your heart, for the wild awaits!
